verdict.rationale: The bizfile page states one account wall before a filer starts. It says that from August 1, 2026, web User Access will be required for Statement of Information filings, and that the online option is only visible to users with access established. It also explains that User Access controls who may file for an entity. Nothing in the evidence lists the full set of steps (account creation, credentials, identity-proofing) a founder must clear before formation or other filings. The portal itself serves a bot-management shell, so those steps cannot be confirmed from the published flow. Missing for 10: an explicit published checklist of account, credential and identity-proofing requirements for formation filings; details of identity verification; confirmation that requirements are disclosed before the flow rather than discovered mid-flow; independent or hands-on corroboration.
